statement.name: EmailExists
statement.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'result' FROM dbo.AC_User a JOIN dbo.People p ON a.UserId = p.UserId JOIN dbo.ContactAddresses c ON p.PersonId = c.EntityId WHERE ContactAddress = '' AND ContactAddressTypeCode = 1 AND a.AccountDisabledDateTime IS NULL

statement.name: GetUserIds
statement.sql: SELECT c.ContactAddress, a.UserId, a.AccountDisabledDateTime, p.FirstName, p.MiddleName, p.LastName FROM dbo.AC_User a JOIN dbo.People p ON a.UserId = p.UserId JOIN dbo.ContactAddresses c ON p.PersonId = c.EntityId WHERE ContactAddress IN () AND ContactAddressTypeCode = 1 AND ContactAddressPurposeCode = 1 -- Primary email
